summary: Join our comprehensive Respiratory Protection and Air Quality Training Course. Learn vital techniques to ensure safety and improve air quality in your workplace
lede: Workplace air-quality assessment and respiratory protection help safety teams identify airborne hazards and choose practical controls. Designed for health, safety, compliance, facilities, operations, and emergency-preparedness professionals, the course covers air-quality monitoring and matching respirators to hazards. It also addresses fit testing, user seal checks, equipment care, and the development of worker training and respiratory protection programs.
audienceIntro: This course targets professionals responsible for health, safety, compliance, and emergency preparedness in environments where air quality and respiratory safety are critical.
audience: Industrial hygiene and occupational safety personnel
modules: Hierarchy of Controls for Airborne Hazards
Fit Testing and User Seal Checks
Airborne Disease and Biological Hazard Prevention
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of workplace safety principles and a commitment to developing their knowledge in respiratory protection and air quality management.
